features.name: Hyper-V
features.description: Microsoft's virtual machine platform and Hyper-V Manager. Needs Windows 11 Pro, Enterprise, or Education and virtualization turned on in the firmware.

features.name: Windows Sandbox
features.description: A throwaway desktop for trying unknown apps. Everything inside is deleted when it closes. Pro, Enterprise, or Education only.

features.name: Windows Subsystem for Linux
features.description: Runs Linux distributions such as Ubuntu. Turn on Virtual Machine Platform too for WSL 2.

features.name: Virtual Machine Platform
features.description: The virtualization layer WSL 2 and Android apps need.

features.name: Windows Hypervisor Platform
features.description: Lets other virtualization apps, such as some Android emulators, run on top of Hyper-V.

features.name: .NET Framework 3.5
features.description: Includes .NET 2.0 and 3.0. Older apps and games ask for it. Windows downloads it from Windows Update.

features.name: NFS client
features.description: Mount NFS network shares, common on Linux servers and NAS devices.

features.name: DirectPlay (legacy games)
features.description: An old networking component some games from the early 2000s still need.

features.name: Telnet client
features.description: The telnet command, handy for testing whether a network port answers.

features.name: TFTP client
features.description: The tftp command, used to flash routers and network gear.
